SECURITY ADVISORY (1/5)                 
========================================
> CVE-2026-124194                       
  MS Outlook: Network Spoofing Flaw     
                                        
  CISA added an active spoofing flaw in 
  Microsoft Outlook to its catalog.     
  Remote unauthenticated actors can     
  exploit missing user interaction      
  checks to forge data across networks. 
  Patch due Nov 24.

  2026-11-24
